project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is stated as Melchett Lake, and the article title confirms this: "Silver Spruce Amends Earn-in Agreement and Acquires 100% Interest in Melchett Lake Zn-Ag- Cu-Au Volcanogenic Massive Sulphide Project, Nakina, Ontario".

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the text: "(TSXV:SSE) - Silver Spruce Resources Inc. ("Silver Spruce" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it acquired a 100% interest in the 112-square kilometre (11,236 ha) Melchett Lake project".

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer is listed in the contact section: "Michael Kinley, CEO and Director".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company acquired a 100% interest in two separate transactions. "Amendment #4 allowed the Company to acquire 100% interest in the Property" and "the Company acquired 100% interest to 22 mining claims".

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as a polymetallic VMS project with Zinc listed first: "Melchett Lake Zn-Ag- Cu-Au Volcanogenic Massive Sulphide Project".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Melchett Lake project and its acquisition by Silver Spruce Resources Inc., which matches the project of interest.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Silver Spruce Resources Inc., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian stock exchange, implying the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD). "The transaction was subject to TSX-V review and acceptance."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of two separate payments from two transactions: a $20,000 payment from the main agreement and a $1,100 payment for additional claims. "...a cash payment of $20,000..." and "The Company paid $1,100 in cash...".

share_payments_raw.justification: The share payment is not provided as an explicit, single monetary value. It is described by the number of shares and their deemed price, which is captured in other fields.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash and share payments are detailed separately in the transaction terms, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total number of shares issued is the sum of two issuances from two transactions: 10,000,000 shares and 350,000 shares. "...the issuance of 10,000,000 common shares of the Company to the Vendors..." and "...issued 350,000 common shares of the Company...".

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No mention of share warrants as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No mention of option payments as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: A single share price cannot be extracted as there were two separate share issuances with two different deemed prices: "at a deemed price of $0.01 per share" and "at a deemed price of $0.015 to the Vendor".

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of meters of drilling was mentioned.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The final agreement explicitly waived any exploration spending commitment: "Additionally, the Vendors agreed to waive the requirement for the Company to incur all remaining exploration expenditures under the Original Agreement."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The property was acquired subject to a retained royalty by the seller: "The Property remains subject to a 2% NSR with buyout provisions".

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area is the sum of the main property (11,236 ha) and the additional claims (448.8 ha). "The Property now covers 11,236 hectares..." and "...acquired 100% interest to 22 mining claims covering 448.8 hectares...".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the area is specified as hectares. "The Property now covers 11,236 hectares..." and "...acquired 100% interest to 22 mining claims covering 448.8 hectares...".

resource_size.justification: The text describes mineralization and historical grades (e.g., "zinc grades to 19.1%") but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate with mass or volume (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are explicitly stated in the text: "(TSXV:SSE) - Silver Spruce Resources Inc."
